title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in mra13 / Team…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Stripe Payments plugin (mra13 / Team Tips and Tricks HQ) affecting versions up to 2.1.4. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
